name: Sculptor of Doom grants an instant Ruin after 3 direct crits (#4758)
contract: Sculptor of Doom 801235 reads 'Landing 3 direct critical strikes now grants Sculptor of Doom (555277)'. 801235 is a FelswornCastDrivers entry (pure HasAura() check, no spell_proc row by design) read in felsworn_casts::OnSpellHitResult (AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp): on a direct, family-20 crit it casts 555276 (Fel Energy, StackAmount 3, native aura stacking, triggered=true) and, once GetStackAmount() reaches 3, removes it and casts 555277. 555277's two effects carry EffectSpellClassMask dword1 = 2, matching Ruin (801895) SpellFamilyFlags[1] = 2, and MiscValue[0] = 10 = SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME with BasePoints -101/DieSides 1 = -100% (AscensionFelswornContracts.cpp explicitly sets MiscValue to SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, confirmed a no-op against the DBC's own value). Ruin's CastingTimeIndex 19 (2500ms) is well under the 10000ms floor Player.cpp's SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME guard checks, so the -100% modifier is not suppressed. Sargeron Smite (802060, family 20, SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, mana cost 0, instant cast, no cooldown) is used as the repeatable direct-crit source; spell_crit_rating 100000 plus spell_hit_rating 10000 make each cast a deterministic crit-hit against a hostile dummy (entry 36). Source review found every link in this chain intact (verdict: ALREADY_WORKS); this scenario proves it end to end, live, rather than by source inspection alone.
